action.content: Can you write a poem about the pros and cons of playing a lot of video games? Please make sure it's at least 40 sentences long (don't forget to add punctuations). You must highlight some words or phrases in your response, like *highlighted phrase*.
action.label: context

action.content:
The screen glows bright with colors vivid and true.
*Digital worlds* await where heroes can be you.
You can travel far to lands you never see.
With just a click, you can fly high in the sky.
The *instant gratification* feels so sweet and free.
You solve complex puzzles with a quick and clever key.
Your friends gather online to laugh and to cheer.
The *social connection* across the miles is clear.
But hours pass by while you stare at the light.
Your *real life* begins to fade into the night.
You miss the sun rising on a quiet day.
You forget to eat or drink a single glass of water.
Your *physical health* starts to suffer greatly.
Your eyes grow tired from staring at the glare.
You sit too long and your back begins to ache.
The *sedentary lifestyle* brings on a heavy weight.
You lose the touch of grass beneath your feet.
You miss the smell of rain on hot pavement streets.
The *isolation* grows when the battery runs low.
You feel alone even though the room is full of noise.
The *addictive loop* pulls you deeper in the dark.
You cannot stop playing when the game is over.
Your *sleep schedule* gets messed up every single night.
You wake up groggy and your mind is not right.
The *financial cost* of new skins adds up fast.
You spend money you did not plan to waste.
Your *family time* shrinks to moments in the morning.
You argue with parents about the time you play.
The *stress relief* is temporary and soon it fades.
Real problems pile up while you are in the maze.
You miss important calls and missed deadlines come.
Your *academic grades* might start to slip away.
The *distraction* from reality becomes a daily way.
Yet the stories told within the game are grand.
The *emotional highs* of winning feel like a band.
You learn strategy and logic in a new way.
You develop patience when the game is hard to play.
The *creative spark* can ignite a new design.
You can express yourself through your avatar's design.
It is a *double-edged sword* that cuts both ways.
It brings joy but also steals away days.
The balance must be found to keep things right.
Play in moderation to keep your spirit bright.
*Time well spent* is better than time well lost.
The world outside waits for you to rest.
